positive_triggers: A feature, migration, architecture, policy, or audit-repair candidate needs design before delivery
Consequential design alternatives or uncertainties remain
negative_triggers: Generate tickets or an implementation plan
Authorize or verify completed production work
preconditions: A direction is selected or can be confirmed as selected
applicability.confidence_or_escalation_rule: Inspect evidence before questioning; stop or route elsewhere when selection, permission, or ownership boundaries cannot be established.

steps: Compare designs or prototype only when needed
Check consistency and seek human approval
branches: Stop grilling early when uncertainty is safely deferrable
Use formal artifacts only when warranted
Hand off to separate strict hardening when authorization-grade validation is required
authoritative_sources: Repository instructions and durable project artifacts

success_conditions: Human-approved design and rollout contract or explicit approval blockers
Delivery can proceed without inventing core requirements
failure_conditions: Blocking evidence conflict has no owner
stop_conditions: Remaining uncertainty is resolved, owned, or safely deferrable
Further questions have lower value than answer burden
rollback_or_recovery: Preserve draft documents and unresolved questions
Route strict validation to a separate capability

allowed_tools: Write for document changes within stated scope
side_effects: Writes design documentation only; never implementation
